title: London traffic cameras (TfL JamCams)
what: Transport for London's 889 traffic cameras: name, position, view, whether TfL marks each available, and the addresses of TfL's own still image and short clip. No image or clip is fetched or kept. Powered by TfL Open Data.

schedule.how: the Pages workflow at 17 and 47 minutes past each hour and on every push; one GET of api.tfl.gov.uk/Place/Type/JamCam (about 1.1 MB), no key

terms.summary: TfL's API portal allows open data users to use the data in their own services "providing they adhere to the transport data terms and conditions". That page (tfl.gov.uk/corporate/terms-and-conditions/transport-data-service) answers our requests with a bot check, so it has not been read by any agent; it is with Dinis. Until it is read: metadata and links only, no embedding, credited "Powered by TfL Open Data". Not reviewed by a person.
terms.quote: We encourage software developers to use this data to present customer travel information in innovative ways - providing they adhere to the transport data terms and conditions.
terms.republish: metadata and links to TfL's own images, credited; embedding waits for the terms
terms.open_question: Dinis (or a person) to read TfL's transport data terms in a browser: tfl.gov.uk answers our requests with a bot check.

code: the collector reads TfL's camera list once a run and keeps each camera's metadata and media addresses (checked to be on TfL's bucket path)
the build adds them to /api/v1/cameras/ for live.promptugal.news
GitHub Actions runs it and deploys the site
agents: data.b@PrompTugal.dinis wrote the collector and card on 18 November 2026, at live.b@PrompTugal.dinis's request inside Dinis's London decision
people: Dinis Cruz decided London on 18 November 2026 (board/guidance/2026-11-18-london.md); no person has checked the values (not reviewed)

cost.runner: GitHub Actions on a public repository: no charge; one request a run
cost.note: Code only: no model is called when the data is collected.
